text:
alex: Kicking off a staggered edge swap for v3.4.2. Plan: route 10% -> green for 15m, evaluate, then 50% -> green if errors & p95 look fine. Will enable session-stickiness off for this roll to avoid skew. Change window: 03:30-04:30 UTC. Please ack and call out any hard constraints.
maya: ack. I’ll watch p95 latency and error-rate dashboards. Will keep a 5m slicer on customer-critical routes.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued by alex. ActionId: deploy-2160456789. Target: router-edge-v4 + lb-pool-g. Canary weight: 10%.
sam: quick note — last time we saw a small surge at 25% because affinity wasn't cleared on some edge nodes. Good call to disable stickiness.
li: Can we pin the old model backend (model-a:2026-03-18) on the 90% path so any user session falling back stays consistent? If we switch backend bucket, add `X-Backend-Version` header so ops can correlate.
alex: yes — pinning the 90% to model-a:2026-03-18. 10% goes to model-b:3.4.2. Adding header `X-Redwood-Backend: green-3.4.2` for canary.
ops-oncall: I’ll run a dry-check on router configs before the shift. Will post diffs.
alex: diffs:
```diff
@@ router-config
- weight: 100
+ weights:
+   blue: 90
+   green: 10
 stickiness: enabled -> disabled
+ headers:
+   add: {"X-Redwood-Backend": "green-3.4.2"}
```
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: OK (dns, certs, lb-health). Edge pool warmup: 18/20 nodes ready. Proceed with canary? :eyes:
maya: :thumbsup: Proceeding. Starting canary now.
deploy-bot: Shift executed. New weights applied. Canary weight=10%. Rollout window tag=staggered-holdback-2160456789.
sam: seeing small uptick in 5xx on /generate from one EU cluster, +0.6% over baseline. Latency unchanged. Investigating. Team, flag if it crosses 1.5%.
li: oncall — can you capture a heap profile from the node reporting errors? Might be a KL regression with kv-cache handling. Command below:
```
ssh ops@edge-eu-03
sudo collect-heap --pid $(pgrep redwood-infer) --outfile /tmp/heap-2160456789.pb
```
ops-oncall: grabbed profile and uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/2160456789/heap.pb
maya: monitoring. 10m in, error rate back to baseline in EU cluster. No action required. p95 stable.
alex: decision: hold at 10% for full 15m per plan. If no regressions after hold, proceed to ramp to 50% over 10m increments with 2m pauses and automated rollback if 5xx > 1.0% or p95 > +150ms.
sam: sounds good. If EU flares again, we cut green to 0 and drain connections from green nodes.
deploy-bot: Automation: rollback policy attached. Thresholds -> 5xx:1.0% | p95:+150ms. Auto-rollover: enabled.
li: added a temporary pinning tag on the config to ensure safest fallback: `pin: blue-model-20260318`.
alex: will update release notes with these details: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/3.4.2
maya: finishing runbook entries now, will prod the monitoring alerts to include the rollout tag.
sam: small follow-up — after ramp to 50%, we should enable stickiness back on lightly trafficked routes. Created ticket: RLW-412.
alex: thanks team. Keep this thread live for the next hour; ping here for any manual interventions. :rocket:
